Page 001
001-1. We will escape tonight.
001-2. FROM THIS CITY.
001-3. PICK ME UP INFINUE ECN ART WASAKBASAK (3B2S) ADAPTATION CHO WOONEH (REDICE STUDIO) ORIGINAL HERMODE
001-4. WE WILL WAIT UNTIL NIGHT FALLS TO ESCAPE.
001-5. SINCE WE WILL BE LESS CAPABLE OF FIGHTING WITH A DIVIDED TEAM, WE CAN'T TRY AND FIGHT OUR WAY OUT.
001-6. THERE ARE ALSO ADVANTAGES, THOUGH.
001-7. WE CAN BE STEALTHIER WITH FEWER PEOPLE IN A GROUP.
001-8. WE CAN ESCAPE WITHOUT HAVING TO FIGHT.
001-9. IF WE DON'T FIGHT, THEN THERE'S NO NEED TO HAVE A MAGE WITH US.
001-10. FIRE MAGIC IS BOUND TO GARNER A LOT OF ATTENTION, SO WE CAN'T HAVE EOLKA WITH US.
001-11. JENNA WILL BE IN THE SAME TEAM AS AARON SO THAT THEY CAN BE MORE FLEXIBLE WITH HOW THEY REACT TO BAD SITUATIONS.
001-12. YOU GUYS GO TO THE EDGE OF THE CITY.
001-13. THERE WILL PROBABLY BE SEARCH TEAMS ALL NIGHT.
001-14. YOU JUST NEED TO TAKE AARON AND RUN AWAY.

Page 002
002-1. I'M SORRY.
002-2. DON'T BE MISTAKEN. I'M NOT KEEPING YOU ALIVE FOR YOUR OWN SAKE.
002-3. YOU TWO,
002-4. IF A TIME COMES WHEN YOU CAN'T PROTECT AARON, JUST ABANDON HIM WITHOUT HESITATION.
002-5. YOUR LIVES ARE OF A HIGHER PRIORITY THAN AN INJURED PERSON, ALRIGHT?
002-6. THEN BREAK IS OVER.
002-7. YOU GUYS GO RIGHT. WE'LL GO LEFT.
002-8. UPLOADED FROM: PICKMEUPGACHA.COM
002-9. Tyy
002-10. REEE
002-11. WHAT ABOUT HIDING PLACES?
002-12. THERE ARE QUITE A FEW.
002-13. THE ALLEYWAYS ARE PRETTY COMPLEX, AND WE CAN GO INSIDE BUILDINGS TOO.
002-14. WE CAN GO INSIDE BUILDINGS?
002-15. I TRIED EARLIER.
002-16. I GUESS IT'S DIFFERENT FROM THE FIFTH FLOOR.
002-17. THAT'S A GOOD THING.

Page 003
003-1. HEY, YOUNG LADY, ARE YOU LOST? Huhu...
003-2. /1 Hiek!
003-3. OR DID YOU RUN AWAY FROM HOME?
003-4. I CAN LEAD YOU SOMEWHERE-
003-5. XIAGH NAM IT'S THE SLUMS, BUT THIS IS A GOOD PLACE TO HIDE.
003-6. THE STREETS ARE LIKE A MAZE, AND THERE ARE A LOT OF BUILDINGS. H
003-7. I'LL GO AHEAD AND LOOK FOR A PLACE TO HIDE.
003-8. RAy RiC
003-9. T TIPS ON LONG-TERM MISSIONS THERE ARE INSTANCES WHEN MISSIONS ARE PROLONGED. EVEN IF THE USER LOGS OUT THE HEROES WILL CONTINUE TO WORK.
003-10. A GUIDE MESSAGE ABOUT LONG MISSIONS.
003-11. IT'S PROBABLY BORING FOR ANYTNG TO WATCH.
003-12. AND THIS KID... AND THIS KID.
003-13. SHE LOOKS NERVOUS, BUT SHE'S STAYING CALM.
003-14. I GUESS SHE'S NO ORDINARY KID.
003-15. HAD SHE BEEN ORDINARY, SHE WOULD'VE REJECTED OUR OFFER TO COME WITH US IN THE FIRST PLACE.
003-16. SHE QUICKLY REALIZED COMING WITH US WAS THE WAY TO LIVE EVEN AMIDST THE CHAOS.

Page 004
004-1. YOU FOUND A GREAT PLACE.
004-2. THERE'S A BACK DOOR TOO, SO WE'LL BE ABLE TO ESCAPE EASILY...
004-3. WE SHOULD HIDE HERE UNTIL IT'S DARK.
004-4. I'M GONNA SET A TRAP BY THE ENTRANCE, SO BE CAREFUL.
004-5. SO WE'RE GONNA SPEND OUR TIME HERE?
004-6. I'LL BE BACK.
004-7. ARE YOU GOING OUT AGAIN?
004-8. I HAVE DUTIES TO FULFILL.
004-9. YOU ALONE ARE ENOUGH TO PROTECT HER.
004-10. I HAVE TO FIND A WAY OUT.
004-11. MAYBE I SHOULD'VE PUT JENNA IN MY PLACE.
004-12. THERE ISN'T MUCH I CAN DO IN A PLACE LIKE THIS.

Page 005
005-1. FRIACIS AL LAGNER.
005-2. FRIACIS AL LAGNER.
005-3. THAT'S MY NAME.
005-4. I AM THE SECOND SUCCESSOR OF THE EMPIRE.
005-5. I GUESS IT DOESN'T WORK ON YOU.
005-6. UPLOADED FROM: PICKMEUPGACHA.COM
005-7. WHERE DID YOU COME FROM?
005-8. NONE OF YOUR BUSINESS.
005-9. I REVEALED MY IDENTITY.
005-10. YOU SHOULD AT LEAST RETURN THE FAVOR.
005-11. YOU WON'T UNDERSTAND EVEN IF I TELL YOU.
005-12. REALLY?
005-13. DID YOU COME FROM A PLACE I DON'T KNOW ABOUT?
005-14. YOU COULD SAY THAT.
005-15. PERHAPS...
005-16. ARE YOU THE SOLDIERS THAT SAVED NELSA?

Page 006
006-1. NELSA.
006-2. WAS THAT THE NAME OF THE CITY ON THE TENTH FLOOR?
006-3. I REMEMBER OVERHEARING THE NPCS TALKING.
006-4. SEEMS LIKE I'M RIGHT.
006-5. 1% I SAW IT IN MY DREAMS.
006-6. ...DREAMS?
006-7. IN THE DREAM, SOLDIERS WERE FIGHTING HARD TO PROTECT A CITY.
006-8. I COULDN'T SEE THEIR FACES,
006-9. BUT I FEEL LIKE YOU WERE THEM.
006-10. NELSA'S SURVIVORS SAID THAT A GROUP OF PEOPLE PROTECT- ED THEM.
006-11. atHA
006-12. THEY SAID THAT IF IT WEREN'T FOR THEM, THE CITY WOULD'VE FALLEN,
006-13. BUT THAT THEY COULDN'T SEE THEIR FACES.
006-14. I'VE BEEN HAVING STRANGE DREAMS FOR A YEAR.
006-15. VERY OMINOUS.
006-16. EVERYTHING WAS ENDING IN THE DREAMS.

Page 007
007-1. THE EMPIRE,
007-2. THE FOUR RENOWNED FAM- ILIES' CITY,
007-3. AND THE SMALL AND BIG CITIES AND VILLAGES.
007-4. EVERYTHING ON THE CONTINENT WAS ON FIRE.
007-5. THOSE DREAMS MADE ME CERTAIN
007-6. THAT AT THIS RATE, THE CONTI- NENT WAS GOING TO MEET ITS END.
007-7. DO YOU KNOW? THERE ARE OMINOUS THINGS OCCURRING ALL OVER THE CONTINENT.
007-8. THERE ARE MYSTERIOUS DISEASES THRIVING, PARASITES,
007-9. AND MONSTERS.
007-10. I ASSUME THE NELSA INVA- SION WAS A PART OF THAT.
007-11. THEY USUALLY DON'T INVADE HUMAN TERRITORY.
007-12. WHY ARE YOU TELLING ME THIS?
007-13. ...I NEED POWER.
007-14. POWER?
007-15. THE POWER TO SAVE THE WORLD.
007-16. YOU WANT ME TO HELP.
007-17. YES.

Page 008
008-1. I DON'T GET WHY YOU'D ASK ME FOR HELP.
008-2. DON'T YOU HAVE INCREDIBLE POWER AS A PRINCESS?
008-3. I'M SURE THERE ARE KNIGHTS IN LINE FOR YOU.
008-4. I'M JUST A SCARECROW. ALL I HAVE IS THE POSITION AS A PRINCESS.
008-5. I HAVE NOTHING ELSE.
008-6. ...NO ONE LISTENS TO ME.
008-7. ...NO ONE OBEYS ME.
008-8. YOU HAVE MONEY. GET SOME MERCENARIES.
008-9. THEN I'LL HIRE YOU AS MY MERCENARY.
008-10. I'LL PAY YOU WHATEVER YOU WANT.
008-11. I MAY BE A SCARECROW, BUT I DO HAVE MONEY.
008-12. NO. LOOK FOR SOMEONE ELSE.
008-13. YOU CAN JUST HIRE SOME OTHER CAPABLE PERSON IF YOU HAVE MONEY.
008-14. NO ONE BELIEVED ME WHEN I TALKED ABOUT MY DREAMS.
008-15. THEY DIDN'T EVEN WANT TO LISTEN TO ME.
008-16. Moy
008-17. BUT YOU WERE DIFFERENT.
008-18. YOU DIDN'T LAUGH AT MY STORY.
008-19. THAT IS WHY I WANT TO HIRE YOU.
008-20. UPLOADED FROM: PICKMEUPGACHA.COM
008-21. ...THIS IS ANNOYING.
008-22. IF THE EXPLANATION I HEARD FROM THE PROMOTION IS TRUE, THIS STAGE IS TOWNIA'S PAST.
008-23. YOU NEED TO MAKE THEM CHANGE THE STORY.
008-24. EVEN IF THE SETTINGS AND PLAUSIBILITY ARE MESSED UP
008-25. AND EVEN IF SPACE AND TIME ARE MIXED UP AND DESTROYED.

Page 009
009-1. EVEN IF I WANTED TO HELP, IT WOULD NOT WORK OUT.
009-2. THIS CHILD IS JUST AN NPC.
009-3. WE WON'T HAVE ANYTHING TO DO WITH EACH OTHER ONCE THIS MISSION IS OVER.
009-4. ...IS THAT A NO?
009-5. I HAVE MY REASONS.
009-6. WHAT REASONS?
009-7. YOU MIGHT LAUGH AT IT.
009-8. We're from a different world.
009-9. B2(RECTUD
